def _axial_load_map(calibration):

    affine = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(loads)), loads))

def _decode(raw, bridge):

    offset, gain, previous, following, cross, cubic = bridge.T
    j = np.arange(4)
    prev, nxt = (j - 1) % 4, (j + 1) % 4
    linear = np.zeros((4, 4))
